answer_1.quote: The task of style transfer on text data involves changing the style of a given sentence while preserving its semantics.
answer_1.outputs: Style-transferred sentences in various styles (e.g., Shakespeare, Twitter, formal, informal)

answer_2.quote: We build our style classifier by fine-tuning RoBERTa-large ... leading to significantly more reliable ACC evaluation.

answer_4.quote: As automatic evaluations are insufficient for evaluating text generation , 17 out of 23 surveyed style transfer papers also conduct human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Given the original sentence and the transferred sentence, annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk can choose one of three options: 0 for no paraphrase relationship; 1 for an ungrammatical paraphrase; and 2 for a grammatical paraphrase.
